summary.text: Blake Huber is the Libertarian Party candidate for U.S. Senate in Colorado. He has appeared on Colorado ballots before, including as an Approval Voting Party candidate for Secretary of State in 2018. No campaign website or candidate survey with a personal biography was found.

paragraphs.text: Blake Huber was the 2016 Approval Voting Party candidate for vice president of the United States, according to Ballotpedia.
In 2018 he ran for Colorado Secretary of State as an Approval Voting Party candidate, receiving 0.5% of the vote (13,258 votes) in the general election won by Jena Griswold.
Ballotpedia's 2024 presidential ballot-access table lists Huber (L) for Colorado with a result of 0% of the vote.
